product_metadata.title: DII Popcorn Bath Rug, 17x24, Eggplant
features: MATERIAL AND SIZE: Made of 100% cotton, this bath mat measures 17x24"; Designed to sit alongside your tub, shower, toilet, sink, or vanity and provide a comfortable, warm, dry spot for you to stand
FIND THE PERFECT RUG: These bath rugs are available in two sizes and in multiple trendy colors to easily match and coordinate with your interior style
SOFT, ABSORBENT, QUICK TO DRY: Soft to the touch with popcorn-like construction, these rugs quickly absorb large amounts of water and dry quickly too
LUXURIOUS YET PRACTICAL: This bath mat is made of high quality material that provides class and comfort to your bathroom while its construction ensures durability
MACHINE WASHABLE AND EASY-CARE: Wash with cold water in gentle cycle with similar colors; Lay flat to dry; Do not bleach; Use of rug pad recommended to avoid transfer of color
description: DII offers full collections of trend based designs, bringing you fresh, innovative lines of quality home products for every season. Let DII products become a valuable part of your life.

details.Product Care Instructions: Machine wash colors separately. Cold water. Gentle cycle. Only non-chlorine bleach when needed. Tumble dry low. Use of rug pad is recommended to avoid transfer of color and prevent slipping. Flammable Fails U.S. Dept of commerce Standard FF2-70. Do not use near sources of ignition.
